bass.summary: Bass instruments intended primarily for low-register monophonic/groove support.
bass.technique_policy: These are useful authoring intents for the family, not a claim that every resolved patch has a dedicated sampled articulation. Instrument/technique maps or synthesis gating determine realization.
writing_tips: Coordinate bass rhythm with kick placement before adding fills.
Use upper-register notes sparingly unless the bass becomes a foreground voice.

brass.technique_policy: These are useful authoring intents for the family, not a claim that every resolved patch has a dedicated sampled articulation. Instrument/technique maps or synthesis gating determine realization.
writing_tips: Use velocity/expression arcs for sustained brass and reserve repeated high attacks for deliberate intensity.

drums.technique_policy: These are useful authoring intents for the family, not a claim that every resolved patch has a dedicated sampled articulation. Instrument/technique maps or synthesis gating determine realization.
writing_tips: Treat velocity as part of the groove, not just loudness.
Use fills and cymbal changes to articulate form rather than repeating an unchanged bar indefinitely.

folk.summary: Folk/ethnic sampled instruments with patch-specific playing behavior.
folk.technique_policy: These are useful authoring intents for the family, not a claim that every resolved patch has a dedicated sampled articulation. Instrument/technique maps or synthesis gating determine realization.
writing_tips: Inspect the instrument-specific usage notes and observed range before exposed writing.

guitar.summary: Guitar-family sampled instruments; prefer guitar-aware generators for rhythm and lead phrasing.
guitar.technique_policy: These are useful authoring intents for the family, not a claim that every resolved patch has a dedicated sampled articulation. Instrument/technique maps or synthesis gating determine realization.
writing_tips: Use guitar.strum/chug/shape_pick for chordal rhythm instead of keyboard block voicings.
Use technique/articulation intent such as palm_mute or staccato when the realization supports it.

keys.technique_policy: These are useful authoring intents for the family, not a claim that every resolved patch has a dedicated sampled articulation. Instrument/technique maps or synthesis gating determine realization.

orchestra.technique_policy: These are useful authoring intents for the family, not a claim that every resolved patch has a dedicated sampled articulation. Instrument/technique maps or synthesis gating determine realization.
writing_tips: Check the specific role and observed patch range before writing exposed extremes.

piano.summary: Piano/keyboard material with broad polyphonic range.
piano.technique_policy: These are useful authoring intents for the family, not a claim that every resolved patch has a dedicated sampled articulation. Instrument/technique maps or synthesis gating determine realization.
writing_tips: Keep dense left-hand voicings above the muddiest octave unless the bass is exposed.

writing_tips: Use sustained lines and voice leading instead of retriggering every chord tone at every beat.
Route pizzicato/tremolo/staccato to dedicated articulations when available.
